findings.current: That night, the beat-up capsule had fearlessly crawled inside itself, then tossed the fool who’d settled down to sleep into a new world.
findings.defect: The draft makes the capsule crawl inside itself. Jin is the one who climbed into it to sleep.
findings.rationale: The Korean describes the fool entering the capsule; the capsule throws him into a new world.
findings.replacement: That night, the beat-up capsule had tossed the fool who’d been reckless enough to crawl inside it for a nap into a new world.
findings.source: 그날 밤, 고물 캡슐은 겁도 없이 자신의 안으로 기어들어 와 잠을 청한 멍청이를 새로운 세상으로 내던졌고

findings.current: One of the beings who’d been replaced like a part, over and over, until Michael Silbert became who he is now.
findings.defect: The wording suggests one being was repeatedly replaced, rather than that successive beings were swapped out like parts.
findings.rationale: Jin is describing a succession of Muninns that contributed to Michael’s present state.
findings.replacement: One of a series of beings swapped out like spare parts to make Michael Silbert who he is today.
findings.source: 몇 번이나 부품처럼 교체되며 지금의 미카엘 실베르트를 있게 만든 존재 중 하나.

findings.rationale: The source specifies 아크 리치, not simply 리치.

findings.current: He’d already realized that the situation was getting serious. Jin Taekyung gestured to him with his chin.
findings.defect: The draft omits Genji’s eyes darting around as he gauges the situation.
findings.rationale: 눈동자만 뒤룩뒤룩 굴리는 supplies a visible cue to Genji’s nerves.
findings.replacement: He’d already realized that the situation was getting serious. As his eyes darted around, Jin Taekyung jerked his chin at him.
findings.source: 눈동자만 뒤룩뒤룩 굴리는 그를 향해 진태경이 턱짓했다.

findings.current: 慎重ness is a leader’s virtue.
findings.defect: An untranslated fragment breaks the English-only reading copy.
findings.rationale: 신중함 means caution or prudence here.

findings.current: I didn’t want anyone else getting caught up in this.
findings.defect: “Anyone else” broadens Jin’s concern beyond the people he considers uninvolved.
findings.rationale: 괜한 사람들 identifies people who need not be drawn into the confrontation.
findings.replacement: I didn’t want people who had nothing to do with this getting caught up in it.
findings.source: 괜한 사람들이 휘말리게 하고 싶지 않았어요.

findings.current: He’d spent each day in a cramped, musty goshiwon room, a tiny, inexpensive room-for-rent lodging.[^1]
findings.defect: The in-line definition repeats the footnote and awkwardly equates a room with a lodging.
findings.rationale: The existing footnote already supplies the useful explanation of 고시원.
findings.replacement: He’d spent each day in a cramped, musty goshiwon room.[^1]
findings.source: 좁고 곰팡내 나는 고시원 방에서 하루하루를 보냈다.

summary: One action is reversed, Muninn’s succession is blurred, and several smaller details need correction.
